findings.desc: quality-cleanup: score.mjs:223 explicit existsSync pre-check before readJsonFile call on line 224 is redundant dead code — readJsonFile at line 77 performs the identical existsSync check and produces the same error message ("missing required run record file: <path>"); the guard on line 223 can never be the only line that catches the missing-file case

quality-cleanup: score-selfcheck.mjs:196 tmpdir()-based digest-stability check may produce a false-pass on macOS — os.tmpdir() can return /var/folders/... while mkdtempSync resolves to a /private/var/folders/... path (symlink target); the string-inclusion check for tmpdir() would miss a leaked resolved path. The corpus variable check on the same line is more reliable. Fix: also check the resolved (realpath) form of tmpdir(), or use only the corpus variable check which is already the actual temp root used

quality-cleanup: score-selfcheck.mjs: the CHK-002 error-path section only pins two error cases (missing run.json, malformed arm); the documented RUN-RECORD.md error catalog includes at least two further required-file errors (activity.jsonl missing, workspace/ missing) that are not pinned as CLI one-line error checks. A scorer that produces a multi-line or wrongly-formatted error for these cases would pass selfcheck undetected. Lines ~387-408 cover only --run missing run.json and arm malformation
